pages.text: The Shallows Temple is a smaller introductory expedition, separate from the regular and Origin Temples. Find its entrance among land-based Overworld ruins. The expedition contains three floors, each arranged as a 5 by 5 maze of familiar Temple modules.
Shallows rewards are limited to Tiers 1 and 2. Explore its rooms carefully, gather food, and watch for Sentinels. Their Ominous Stones may rarely yield a Shard of Divinity.
